messages: Yeh jo points wallet me jama ho rahe hai unka kya benefit hai?

Ramesh ji, every quarter ko based on points hum gifts dete hai 🎁 ✅ 5,000 points — Prestige Pressure Cooker ✅ 8,000 points — Mixer Grinder ✅ 15,000 points — Refrigerator gift mil sakta hai Aapke current points ka status check karein?

screens.description: Credit Note Alternative ZoAi explains that points below the gift threshold are converted to a credit note adjusted against the next bill — zero confusion, zero call needed.

Aapke points ke anusar aapko credit note mil sakta hai jo aapke bill ke against adjust keeya jayega 📄 Yeh credit note aapke agle order mein seedha discount ke roop mein apply hoga.
